item.title: A Speech for Graduation Day
item.prompt_text: You have been chosen to give a speech at your university graduation ceremony on behalf of your year group. Write the speech. It should be warm and personal but also offer your classmates a meaningful message about the future.
item.target_grammar: rhetorical devices (tricolon, rhetorical questions, parallelism); varied sentence length for effect
item.target_structure: address the audience + shared memories + thanks + reflection on uncertainty + central message + memorable close

checklist.point: Address the audience and acknowledge the occasion
Reflect on the future and its uncertainty
Deliver a central message and a memorable close
